expected.sql: WITH fx AS (SELECT (SELECT rate FROM exchange_rates WHERE currency_pair='USD_CNY' AND fetched_at < (sp.etd::date + INTERVAL '1 day') ORDER BY fetched_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS rate, sp.* FROM shipping_plans sp WHERE sp.etd >= $1::date AND sp.etd < $2::date AND NULLIF(sp.bl_no,'') IS NOT NULL) SELECT bl_no AS customs_no, bl_no, container_no, contract_no, forwarder_cn AS factory_name, forwarder_company_id AS factory_code, pol, pod, etd, freight_term, container_qty, ROUND(COALESCE(freight_cost,0) * COALESCE(rate, (SELECT rate FROM exchange_rates WHERE currency_pair='USD_CNY' ORDER BY fetched_at DESC LIMIT 1)) + COALESCE(port_surcharge_total,0), 2) AS expected_amount, NULL::timestamptz AS confirmed_at, 'CNY' AS currency FROM fx

actual.sql: SELECT sp.bl_no, p.id AS payment_id, p.payment_date, COALESCE(p.this_amount, p.amount, p.paid_amount) AS actual_amount, p.pay_item, p.pay_type FROM finance_payments p JOIN shipping_plans sp ON (sp.id::text = p.plan_id::text OR sp._id::text = p.plan_id::text) WHERE p.direction='out' AND (p.pay_item IN ('freight','运费') OR p.pay_type IN ('货代海运费','货代港杂费','货代物流费') OR p.pay_item ILIKE '%海运%') AND NULLIF(sp.bl_no,'') IS NOT NULL
